dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Since you asked, I'd quite like to talk about my arch nemesis, Alice.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: I'm not asking you to take sides. Witches have all sorts of tricks up their sleeves to beguile and ensnare the unwary, so I don't blame you for falling under her spell.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: But you're smart, so I trust your judgment. Before long, the spell will fade, and you'll see her for who she really is!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: What I really wanted to say is that lately I've been wondering... Why is it that every time I think I've won, things always just seem to end up going the way she planned?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Ugh, it's so frustrating! I need someone who understands witches to help me work it out...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: What's the logic behind Alice's schemes?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: C'mon, you're smart. Help me figure out a way to turn the tables. I wanna give her a taste of what it's like to miscalculate for once!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you considered that maybe Alice's schemes don't follow any normal logic?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: That's it! That wicked witch does whatever she wants! Acting without regard for others in pursuit of her own ideas of fun!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: So then, what's the best way to deal with her?

choices.text: Throw a tantrum and roll around on the floor...?

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Why would I do that? Screaming and shouting and annoying everyone nearby... People would hate me.

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Wait a second... Something's wrong here. You're not the Traveler at all, are you? You're a witch in disguise!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Reveal yourself! I know it's you!

choices.text: What I was trying to say is... Stop overthinking everything.

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Hmm... I don't think that's something I can do so easily...

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: But I can try to learn a thing or two from Klee and the others...

choices.text: Why not let yourself be a child for once and do whatever you want?
